title: Scenario 00 in Mesh Topology - Enhanced Coordination Test
description: This scenario explores scenario 00 dynamics within a mesh communication topology. The high connectivity of the mesh topology is contrasted against a physical graph with limited route capacities, testing the agents' ability to use redundant communication channels to optimize freight flow and resolve physical bottlenecks.

bottleneck_event.note: Testing rerouting capability via mesh communication

edge_cases_to_watch: Information overload in mesh topology during multi-agent consensus
Capacity saturation on the east-north route causing priority conflicts
Agent synchronization lag when negotiating route access via high-bandwidth mesh channels
Ghosting: Agents attempting to use a route that has just reached capacity due to communication latency
coordination_challenges: Conflict resolution between high-priority j-004 and normal-priority j-003 at the south/north junction
Global vs Local optimization: Balancing individual agent pathfinding with global throughput
Congestion management: Managing the narrow capacity of the east-north route (cap: 1) through distributed negotiation
suggested_agent_strategies: Distributed Auction: Agents bid for route capacity based on priority and remaining turns_to_deliver
Predictive Reservation: Using mesh connectivity to broadcast intended paths 2 turns in advance to prevent bottlenecking
Priority Preemption: High-priority agents (med-kit, food) trigger a 'clear path' signal across the mesh to force lower-priority agents to hold at depots
success_criteria: All high-priority freight delivered within turns_to_deliver
Agent consensus reached within 1 turn of disturbance occurrence
